name: Islam
summary: A tradition centred on the Qur’an and the prophethood of Muhammad, organised at launch into the Sunni, Shia, Ibadi and Ahmadiyya branches.

currents.name: Sufism
currents.summary: A devotional and mystical current running across Sunni and Shia branches alike; per spec §2.2 it is never rendered as a lane.

currents.name: Salafism
currents.summary: A reformist current appealing to the practice of the earliest generations, cutting across existing branches.
